text:
emma (Docs): Opening a small cleanup PR to LumenX-4B model card: clarify supported quant tags, add a compact perf table for seq=512/2048, and a migration note for q4_0 users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12456 cc @raj @nina @oliver

raj (Eng ML): I ran quick benches. a100x2 fp16: 318 tok/s @512, 136 tok/s @2048. t4 q4_1: ~94 tok/s @512. Embed dim is 2048 (fixing previous 1024 typo). Will drop CSV in PR.

nina (Runtime): Note: runtime 1.8 may fallback old q4_0 to CPU and show KV errors. Docs should recommend runtime >=1.9 and list supported quant tags: fp16, q4_1, q5. Add a troubleshooting line: check `redwoodctl runtime show-version` and `--log-quant-fallback`.

oliver (DevEx): I'll add 2 SDK snippets: python streaming generate and embed example with shard_hint. Keeping them tiny. Pushing node snippet after that.

pat (QA): Verified latencies: p50 ~30ms/token (512 fp16), p95 ~75ms/token. For q4_1 on t4 p50 ~100ms. Formatting the perf table now.

ci-bot (bot): PR #12456: lint OK, link-check OK.

emma (Docs): Two final asks: 1) explicit "quant tags supported" list in compatibility section; 2) short migration note titled "Customers using q4_0" explaining upgrade path. Then we can merge.

raj (Eng ML): Added a short eval note about small quality delta on long summaries (promptset-2026-08).

nina (Runtime): Added the runtime + CPU memory increase note (~30%) to Operational considerations.

oliver (DevEx): Node snippet pushed. Minor SDK naming updated to match v3.

emma (Docs): Merged. Scheduling for docs release v1.28. Thanks!
